_meta.description: Formal registry of Lab changes per sequence completion
_meta.note: Documents existing progression_delta data from map variants + adds nature/capability layers for future phases. This is the single source of truth for Lab evolution.

categories.navigation: Enables reaching new areas (ramps, transport cubes, teleporters)

_meta.architecture_note: Two lab styles exist: 'old-style' (walled rooms 16x30, structure codes 1-6, corridors) used for spine stages, and 'new-style' (diagonal spiral, open floor) used for some branch post-maps. The manifest documents the old-style spine progression.

nature_roadmap.principle: Each QFEP phase brings a category of organic life. The Lab transforms from sterile to alive.

F_order.why: Geometry = crystalline structure. Order creates minerals.

E_entropy.why: Entropy = decomposition. Randomness feeds fungal life.

lambda_edge.why: Edge of chaos = growth. L-systems and fractals become botany.

integration.why: Integration = collective life. Swarms become fauna.

synthesis.why: Synthesis = ecosystem. All prior life integrates. The Lab is a forest.

capability_roadmap.principle: Each sequence grants a perception + capability + relation. The player accumulates ways of seeing.

layering.perception: How you see differently after this sequence
layering.capability: What you can now do in the Lab
layering.relation: How this connects you to something beyond yourself
